video_title: Boogie - Celtics DOWNGRADED Trading Jaylen Brown! Are they TOP 3 in East?

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams respects the Celtics as a top Eastern Conference team
quotes.excerpt: I'm still going to give them the respect of being one of the top teams
quotes.quote: I'm going to give these guys the benefit of the doubt. Last year we doubted these guys and Jaylen Brown went out and did a tremendous job in leading his team and putting them in a position to be successful. I have that same love and admiration and respect for Jayson Tatum and being able to do the same thing. You go out and get a Mitchell Robinson, you go get a Paul George, and that is a group that has shown that they can play well together and they can plug and play guys. Joe Mazzulla being at the helm of that, Payton Pritchard being able to have an opportunity to play a bigger part. I'm still going to give them the respect of being one of the top teams in the East that they've been all year in the last few seasons.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons believes the Celtics remain a well-oiled machine
quotes.excerpt: I think the Celtics are just a well-oiled machine, they're well-coached
quotes.quote: I totally agree. I think the Celtics are just a well-oiled machine, they're well-coached, they're going to defend, they're going to play the right style of basketball, they're going to shoot a bunch of three-pointers. When I saw that trade, I was like, what the hell, they just traded basically Jaylen Brown straight up for Paul George? It made no sense to me. But now I think it just shows you they have belief in Payton Pritchard, they have belief in Derrick White, and they truly think Jayson Tatum is back to 100% after coming off his big injury.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins questions the Celtics' offensive gravity without a second star
quotes.excerpt: I'm not that convinced yet that this was the right move.
quotes.quote: I'm not that convinced yet that this was the right move. When I think about their playing style and I think about how they like to get the three-ball up and how those open looks are created off of their gravity. Outside of Jayson Tatum who I think is an incredible player still, he creates that gravity for that Boston Celtics offense. Usually in the past they had that other option that could also create those looks as well. So that's my only concern and obviously you can think of a guy like Derrick White as an option that could be that replacement to create. I'm not totally convinced with that as of yet, but it is a possibility.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons predicts Mitchell Robinson will lead the NBA in rebounds
quotes.excerpt: I think Mitchell Robinson leads the NBA in rebounds this year.
quotes.quote: I think Mitchell Robinson leads the NBA in rebounds this year. Just the way they play, I think he's going to average six, seven offensive rebounds a game. I think he is a huge signing for them just in the way they play with that physicality and rebounding. I think he is going to have a big-time rebounding year.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins doubts Mitchell Robinson's impact on rebounding
quotes.excerpt: I don't see him being able to get under that rim and have that much impact.
quotes.quote: I don't see him being able to get under that rim and have that much impact under the rim with rebounding for the way that they play.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins ranks the top four teams in the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: Knicks one, Celtics, Cavs, maybe Detroit.
quotes.quote: Knicks one, Celtics, Cavs, maybe Detroit. I don't know if the Pistons got better.
